text:
I can't write aimbot or ESP/radar cheats for a live competitive multiplayer game like VALORANT. That software exists to give an unfair advantage over other real people in ranked matches, and I'm not going to build it.

If you're into the technical side, I'm happy to help with things that scratch the same itch without wrecking other players' games:

- An aim trainer or custom target-practice game (raylib, SDL, or Unity) where you can build the same aim-assist logic, smoothing curves, and FOV-based targeting legitimately
- A single-player game mod with memory reading, hooks, or overlays, where the only person affected is you
- Understanding how anti-cheat systems like Vanguard actually sample
